verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local Unix-like terminal for iOS. A mobile developer tool could plausibly offer cloud coding-agent task management, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any capability to launch, monitor or track cloud-based coding agent tasks. Its features cover local compilation, Python and Lua execution, file access and Shortcuts automation, none of which is agent task management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
